prompt:
Generate 450 diverse code search queries in English.

STRICT Category Definitions:

LEXICAL (30%) - Exact identifier search
- PascalCase: AuthService, UserRepository, HttpClient
- camelCase: getUserById, validateToken, handleRequest
- snake_case: max_retry_count, api_base_url, db_pool_size
- SCREAMING_SNAKE: MAX_CONNECTIONS, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, API_VERSION
- File paths: AuthService.java, utils/helpers.ts, config.yml
- Glob patterns: *Controller.java, get*, *.proto
- Package names: com.example.service, @angular/core

SEMANTIC (30%) - Conceptual understanding
- Questions: how does authentication work, why is caching needed
- Processes: user login flow, data validation process
- Architecture: system design for notifications, error handling strategy

STRUCTURAL (20%) - Code relationships
- Callers: what calls AuthService, callers of validateToken
- Callees: what does AuthService call, dependencies of UserRepository
- Implementations: classes implementing Repository, who extends BaseService
- Impact: impact of changing AuthService, what depends on UserModel

HYBRID (20%) - Mixed identifier + concept
- AuthService login flow, how getUserById handles errors
- UserRepository caching strategy, validation in AuthController

Output format: JSON array [{"query": "...", "label": "LEXICAL|SEMANTIC|STRUCTURAL|HYBRID", "subtype": "...", "difficulty": "easy|medium|hard"}]
